title: Second iOS 27.3 and macOS Golden Gate 27.3 Public Betas Now Available
content:
Apple today seeded the second betas of iOS 27.3, iPadOS 27.3, macOS Golden Gate 27.3, tvOS 27.3, and watchOS 27.3. Apple also has revised betas of of iOS 27.3 and iPadOS 27.3 available for developers.


iOS 27.3 is a major update that adds a Vertical Tabs layout option and Adaptive Dark Mode for Safari. Siri AI can do more in and across Apple's apps, and developers are now able to create actions for ‌Siri‌ to carry out.

In the second developer beta, Apple introduced a facial unlock feature for the iPhone Duo that uses the front camera, along with an option to lock the ‌iPhone Duo‌ when it's closed.

The redesigned Health app is now available with custom Insights and Longevity information, and the ‌iPhone Duo‌ supports Reachability. There's a new Selfie Sing feature in Apple Music, plus changes to StandBy on non-Duo iPhones. Apple has started testing Apple Intelligence and ‌Siri‌ AI usage limits, with extra access available through iCloud+ plans. A full list of what's new in the beta can be found in our guide.

On the Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4, Audio Intelligence features Live Rewind and ‌Siri‌ Recap are available for testing. Live Rewind creates a transcript of the last 15 seconds of speech, and ‌Siri‌ Recap offers a high-level summary of conversations throughout the day.

‌macOS Golden Gate‌ 27.3 has the same Safari features, and it brings Live Activities to Macs without a Dynamic Island.

To get the new betas, you can sign up on Apple's beta testing website. After you're signed up, the betas can be installed through the Software Update section in the Settings app on each device.

We're expecting all of Apple's updates to launch in December.
